description:
Use this when you need an auditable Thailand working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when this is a Bank of Thailand financial-institution calendar, not a universal Thai employee, government, employer, exchange or payment-settlement calendar. Bangkok-only, Islamic-bank and southern-branch conditions remain explicit and are not generalized.
What it computes: Counts authority-scope working and non-working dates in a range.
Example user requests: Count Thailand working days around 2027 substitution. | Count Thailand working days around Bangkok-only event remains conditional.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2027-04-13","end_date":"2027-04-15","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/thailand-financial-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/thailand-financial-working-days-between.md
name: count_th_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Thailand financial institutions and specialized financial institutions

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

substitute_day_policy.description: BOT_substitution_events_are_pinned; no new substitution is inferred

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Thailand Working Days
